title: Upload File Init
content:
# Path: /open/202512/file/init
# Method: [POST]
# Function Description
Use this API to initialize a file upload session. Then upload the file to the returned upload URL. Files of 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes) or less must be uploaded as a single, non-chunked request with `total_chunk_count` set to `1`; larger files use a multipart upload. After the upload step returns a ResourceId, pass that ResourceId to the API for the target path.
For more details, see https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/wfi3nz36.

---

# Request Body Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| file_name | string | Y | video_20251201.mp4 | The name of the file to upload for this upload session. |
| file_type | string | Y | video | The type of file to upload. Currently, only video is supported. |
| file_size | int | Y | 1024 | file size, bytes |
| total_chunk_count | int | Y | 1 | The total number of upload chunks. Must be greater than 0. For files of 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes) or less, set this value to 1. |
| target_path | string | Y | [POST]/affiliate_seller/202501/images/upload | After the video is uploaded, use this interface to bind the video resource to the specific material |
# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/open/202512/file/init?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268
```

**Body**
```json
{"file_name":"video_20251201.mp4","file_type":"video","file_size":1024,"total_chunk_count":1,"target_path":"[POST]/affiliate_seller/202501/images/upload"}
```
